title: [BUG] MCP Timeout needs to be configurable
body:
## Environment
- Platform (select one):
  - [x] Anthropic API
  - [ ] AWS Bedrock
  - [ ] Google Vertex AI
  - [ ] Other: <!-- specify -->
- Claude CLI version:0.2.36
- Operating System: MacOS
- Terminal:  Ghostty

## Bug Description
MCP timeout error when using browser use

## Steps to Reproduce
1. install browser_use mcp
2. tell claude code to search
3. search takes too long and claude code times out with a -32000: Connection closed

## Expected Behavior
Complete Search

## Actual Behavior
Timeout
author: workingdoge
